PROPOSED WRITING. Not a finished article. Do not publish or backdate.

## Why this note

Experiments are harder to interpret when people interact. A treatment given to one person can change outcomes for others through a network.

## Possible sections

1. The usual no-interference assumption and why network data make it implausible.
2. What changes in the estimand: direct effects, spillover, and equilibrium responses.
3. Design choices that are already used in network settings, without inventing new results.
4. Connection to my research on social interactions and school or professional networks, only where a published paper actually supports the point.
5. Open questions I still want to write about carefully.

## Sources to use if this is drafted later

- Existing published papers on network formation and school interactions.
- Do not add unpublished experimental results from industry work.
